Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Roland X-Frame Coffee Table, 36"W, Pine
Colors: Walnut + Metal
Materials: stone
36"L x 36"W x 18"H Solid pine top with metal frame Industrial, rustic and modern touches come together in a piece that blends with most décor This sturdy piece will last through years of family movie nights and entertaining guests Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This wood and metal coffee table combines elements of industrial and rustic, allowing it to blend with many styles. The solid pine wood top has a natural distressed finish, while the metal base has modern "x" frames on either end.
